purpose: Select AudioForge DeepFilter runtime controls and verify LL/Standard wet-dry alignment; no DPDFNet candidate is evaluated.

alignment_gate.required: measured wet lag equals declared latency, 0% is delayed dry, and 50% equals the samplewise mean of aligned wet and dry

attenuation_decision.selection_rule: lowest attenuation limit passing every gate; otherwise retain 80 dB

post_filter_decision.selection_rule: smallest positive beta passing every upgrade gate; otherwise retain 0
